search.query: $base_search$ | eval group_value=if("$group_by$"="source", source, sourcetype) | eval group_value=coalesce(group_value,"unknown") | stats count by group_value | sort group_value

$base_search$ | head $sample_limit$ | eval group_value=if("$group_by$"="source", source, sourcetype) | eval group_value=coalesce(group_value,"unknown") | eval selected_group=if(len("$selected_group$")=0,"*","$selected_group$") | eval selected_group_wrapped="|" . selected_group . "|" | where selected_group="*" OR like(selected_group_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_group_wrapped,"%|" . group_value . "|%")
| eval is_json=if(match(_raw,"^\s*[\{\[]"),1,0) | eval is_xml=if(match(_raw,"^\s*<[^>]+>"),1,0) | rex max_match=0 field=_raw "(?:^|\s)(?<kv_pairs>[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,100}\s*=\s*(?:\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*'|[^\s]+))" | eval kv_count=mvcount(kv_pairs) | eval is_kv=if(kv_count>=3,1,0) | eval has_delimiter=if(match(_raw,"[,|;\t]"),1,0) | eval is_delimited=if(is_json=0 AND is_xml=0 AND is_kv=0 AND has_delimiter=1,1,0) | eval raw_len=len(_raw) | eval raw_shape=replace(_raw,"\b\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3}\b","IP") | eval raw_shape=replace(raw_shape,"\b([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){2,}[0-9a-fA-F:]*\b","IP") | eval raw_shape=replace(raw_shape,"[A-Fa-f0-9]{8,}","HEX") | eval raw_shape=replace(raw_shape,"\d+","N") | eval raw_shape=trim(replace(raw_shape,"\s+"," ")) | eval structure_hint=if(is_json=1 OR is_xml=1 OR is_kv=1 OR is_delimited=1,1,0)
| eventstats count as event_count avg(structure_hint) as structure_ratio dc(raw_shape) as distinct_shapes avg(raw_len) as avg_raw_len stdev(raw_len) as stdev_raw_len values(tag) as observed_tags by group_value
| eval shape_ratio=if(event_count>0,round(distinct_shapes/event_count,4),0) | eval length_variance=if(avg_raw_len>0,round(stdev_raw_len/avg_raw_len,4),0) | eval structure_score=round(structure_ratio*100,0) | eval consistency_score=round(max(0,min(100,100-(shape_ratio*100)-(length_variance*25))),0)
| eval observed_tags_joined=mvjoin(observed_tags,"|||") | eval group_key=group_value . "###" . event_count . "###" . observed_tags_joined . "###" . structure_score . "###" . consistency_score . "###" . distinct_shapes . "###" . shape_ratio . "###" . length_variance
| foreach * [ eval present_<<FIELD>>=if(isnotnull('<<FIELD>>'),"<<FIELD>>",null()) ]
| fields group_key present_* | untable group_key temp_field field_name | rex field=group_key "^(?<group_value>.*?)###(?<event_count>\d+)###(?<observed_tags_joined>.*?)###(?<structure_score>[-\d.]+)###(?<consistency_score>[-\d.]+)###(?<distinct_shapes>\d+)###(?<shape_ratio>[-\d.]+)###(?<length_variance>[-\d.]+)$" | eval observed_tags=split(observed_tags_joined,"|||") | eval event_count=tonumber(event_count) | eval structure_score=tonumber(structure_score) | eval consistency_score=tonumber(consistency_score) | eval distinct_shapes=tonumber(distinct_shapes) | eval shape_ratio=tonumber(shape_ratio) | eval length_variance=tonumber(length_variance)
| eval field_name=replace(field_name,"^present_","") | eval field_name=lower(field_name) | where NOT match(field_name,"^_") | where field_name!="group_value" | where field_name!="event_count" | where field_name!="observed_tags"
| stats count as field_instances values(observed_tags) as observed_tags max(event_count) as event_count max(structure_score) as structure_score max(consistency_score) as consistency_score max(distinct_shapes) as distinct_shapes max(shape_ratio) as shape_ratio max(length_variance) as length_variance by group_value field_name
| join type=left max=0 field_name [ | inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | stats values(datamodel) as datamodels by field_name ]
| eval in_datamodel=if(isnotnull(datamodels),1,0) | fields group_value field_name field_instances observed_tags event_count structure_score consistency_score distinct_shapes shape_ratio length_variance datamodels in_datamodel

div.div: Information Nexus for investigating telemetry quality evidence across structure, consistency, CIM alignment, tagging and governance mappings.

div.p: What this shows: Average quality scores across the selected telemetry for five evidence-based dimensions.
How to use it: Use this as the first view of where data quality is strong and where investigation should focus.
Read it as: These are telemetry quality indicators, not compliance scores. Low values identify where data may be harder to trust, govern, normalise, or operationalise.

search.query:
| eventstats dc(field_name) as current_fields dc(eval(if(in_datamodel=1,field_name,null()))) as matched_dm_fields by group_value
| eval datamodels=if(isnull(datamodels),"__none__",datamodels) | mvexpand datamodels | rename datamodels as datamodel
| join type=left max=0 datamodel [ | inputlookup cim_datamodel_tags_lookup | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval expected_tag=lower(trim(expected_tag)) | stats values(expected_tag) as expected_tags by datamodel ]
| join type=left max=0 datamodel [ | inputlookup governance_datamodel_mapping_lookup | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval framework=trim(framework) | stats values(framework) as frameworks by datamodel ]
| eval observed_tags=mvmap(observed_tags, lower(trim(observed_tags))) | eval expected_tags=if(isnull(expected_tags),"__no_expected_tag__",expected_tags) | mvexpand expected_tags | eval has_expected_tag_mapping=if(expected_tags!="__no_expected_tag__",1,0) | eval tag_hit=if(has_expected_tag_mapping=1 AND mvfind(observed_tags, expected_tags)>=0,1,0) | eval governance_mapped=if(isnotnull(frameworks),1,0)
| stats max(structure_score) as structure_score max(consistency_score) as consistency_score max(current_fields) as current_fields max(matched_dm_fields) as matched_dm_fields dc(eval(if(datamodel!="__none__",datamodel,null()))) as total_matched_datamodels dc(eval(if(has_expected_tag_mapping=1 AND datamodel!="__none__",datamodel,null()))) as taggable_datamodels dc(eval(if(tag_hit=1 AND datamodel!="__none__",datamodel,null()))) as tagged_datamodels dc(eval(if(governance_mapped=1 AND datamodel!="__none__",datamodel,null()))) as mapped_datamodels by group_value
| eval cim_score=round(if(current_fields>0,(matched_dm_fields/current_fields)*100,0),0) | eval tagging_score=case(taggable_datamodels>0,round((tagged_datamodels/taggable_datamodels)*100,0), total_matched_datamodels>0,50, true(),50) | eval governance_score=case(total_matched_datamodels>0,round((mapped_datamodels/total_matched_datamodels)*100,0), true(),50) | eval overall_quality_score=round((structure_score+consistency_score+cim_score+tagging_score+governance_score)/5,0)
| stats avg(structure_score) as Structure avg(consistency_score) as Consistency avg(cim_score) as "CIM Alignment" avg(tagging_score) as Tagging avg(governance_score) as "Governance Context" avg(overall_quality_score) as Overall
| foreach * [ eval <<FIELD>>=round('<<FIELD>>',0) ] | transpose 0 column_name="Quality Dimension" | rename "row 1" as "Score"

panel.title: Data Quality Summary by Data Source

div.p: What this shows: A grouped quality summary across structure, consistency, CIM alignment, tagging and governance mapping.
How to use it: Use this table to identify which Data Source groups are ready for use and which need engineering review.
Read it as: Overall quality combines multiple objective signals. It should guide investigation, not replace human review.

| eventstats dc(field_name) as current_fields dc(eval(if(in_datamodel=1,field_name,null()))) as matched_dm_fields by group_value

| stats max(event_count) as event_count max(structure_score) as structure_score max(consistency_score) as consistency_score max(current_fields) as current_fields max(matched_dm_fields) as matched_dm_fields dc(eval(if(datamodel!="__none__",datamodel,null()))) as matched_datamodel_count dc(eval(if(has_expected_tag_mapping=1 AND datamodel!="__none__",datamodel,null()))) as taggable_datamodels dc(eval(if(tag_hit=1 AND datamodel!="__none__",datamodel,null()))) as tagged_datamodels dc(eval(if(governance_mapped=1 AND datamodel!="__none__",datamodel,null()))) as mapped_datamodels by group_value
| eval cim_score=round(if(current_fields>0,(matched_dm_fields/current_fields)*100,0),0) | eval tagging_score=case(taggable_datamodels>0,round((tagged_datamodels/taggable_datamodels)*100,0), matched_datamodel_count>0,50, true(),50) | eval governance_score=case(matched_datamodel_count>0,round((mapped_datamodels/matched_datamodel_count)*100,0), true(),50) | eval overall_quality_score=round((structure_score+consistency_score+cim_score+tagging_score+governance_score)/5,0) | eval quality_band=case(overall_quality_score>=85,"Excellent",overall_quality_score>=70,"Good",overall_quality_score>=50,"Needs Review",true(),"Poor") | eval issue_count=0 | eval issue_count=issue_count+if(structure_score<60,1,0)+if(consistency_score<60,1,0)+if(cim_score<40,1,0)+if(tagging_score<60,1,0)+if(governance_score<60,1,0)
| rename group_value as "Data Source" | rename overall_quality_score as "Overall Quality Score" | rename quality_band as "Quality Band" | rename structure_score as "Structure Score" | rename consistency_score as "Consistency Score" | rename cim_score as "CIM Alignment Score" | rename tagging_score as "Tagging Score" | rename governance_score as "Governance Mapping Score" | rename issue_count as "Quality Issue Count" | rename matched_datamodel_count as "Matched Datamodel Count" | rename taggable_datamodels as "Taggable Datamodels" | rename tagged_datamodels as "Tagged Datamodels" | table "Data Source" "Quality Band" "Overall Quality Score" "Structure Score" "Consistency Score" "CIM Alignment Score" "Tagging Score" "Governance Mapping Score" "Quality Issue Count" event_count current_fields matched_dm_fields "Matched Datamodel Count" "Taggable Datamodels" "Tagged Datamodels" | sort "Quality Band" - "Quality Issue Count" "Overall Quality Score"

div.p: What this shows: Specific quality concerns raised by the scoring dimensions.
How to use it: Use this as the work queue for investigation, onboarding review, CIM alignment, tagging cleanup, or governance mapping updates.
Read it as: These are evidence-led indicators. They should start the engineering conversation rather than act as automated remediation instructions.

search.query:
| eventstats dc(field_name) as current_fields dc(eval(if(in_datamodel=1,field_name,null()))) as matched_dm_fields by group_value
| eval datamodels=if(isnull(datamodels),"__none__",datamodels) | mvexpand datamodels | rename datamodels as datamodel
| join type=left max=0 datamodel [ | inputlookup cim_datamodel_tags_lookup | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval expected_tag=lower(trim(expected_tag)) | stats values(expected_tag) as expected_tags by datamodel ]
| join type=left max=0 datamodel [ | inputlookup governance_datamodel_mapping_lookup | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval framework=trim(framework) | stats values(framework) as frameworks by datamodel ]
| eval observed_tags=mvmap(observed_tags, lower(trim(observed_tags))) | eval expected_tags=if(isnull(expected_tags),"__no_expected_tag__",expected_tags) | mvexpand expected_tags | eval has_expected_tag_mapping=if(expected_tags!="__no_expected_tag__",1,0) | eval tag_hit=if(has_expected_tag_mapping=1 AND mvfind(observed_tags, expected_tags)>=0,1,0) | eval governance_mapped=if(isnotnull(frameworks),1,0)
| stats max(event_count) as event_count max(structure_score) as structure_score max(consistency_score) as consistency_score max(distinct_shapes) as distinct_shapes max(shape_ratio) as shape_ratio max(length_variance) as length_variance max(current_fields) as current_fields max(matched_dm_fields) as matched_dm_fields dc(eval(if(datamodel!="__none__",datamodel,null()))) as matched_datamodel_count dc(eval(if(has_expected_tag_mapping=1 AND datamodel!="__none__",datamodel,null()))) as taggable_datamodels dc(eval(if(tag_hit=1 AND datamodel!="__none__",datamodel,null()))) as tagged_datamodels dc(eval(if(governance_mapped=1 AND datamodel!="__none__",datamodel,null()))) as mapped_datamodels by group_value
| eval cim_score=round(if(current_fields>0,(matched_dm_fields/current_fields)*100,0),0) | eval tagging_score=case(taggable_datamodels>0,round((tagged_datamodels/taggable_datamodels)*100,0), matched_datamodel_count>0,50, true(),50) | eval governance_score=case(matched_datamodel_count>0,round((mapped_datamodels/matched_datamodel_count)*100,0), true(),50)
| eval issue=mvappend( if(structure_score<60,"Low structure signal: events may need parsing or onboarding review",null()), if(consistency_score<60,"High event variation: event shapes or lengths are inconsistent",null()), if(event_count<50,"Low sample size: quality confidence may be limited",null()), if(cim_score<40,"Low CIM alignment: observed fields have limited datamodel coverage",null()), if(tagging_score<60,"Low tagging evidence: related CIM tags were not consistently observed",null()), if(governance_score<60,"Low governance mapping: matched datamodels have incomplete governance guidance",null()) ) | eval issue_count=mvcount(issue) | where issue_count>0
| eval severity=case( mvfind(issue,"Low structure signal: events may need parsing or onboarding review")>=0,"High", mvfind(issue,"High event variation: event shapes or lengths are inconsistent")>=0,"High", mvfind(issue,"Low CIM alignment: observed fields have limited datamodel coverage")>=0,"High", mvfind(issue,"Low tagging evidence: related CIM tags were not consistently observed")>=0,"High", true(),"Medium" )
| eval issue=mvsort(issue) | eval issue=mvjoin(issue,"; ")
| rename group_value as "Data Source" | rename issue as "Issues"
| table "Data Source" severity "Issues" event_count structure_score consistency_score cim_score tagging_score governance_score matched_datamodel_count taggable_datamodels tagged_datamodels mapped_datamodels
| sort severity "Data Source"

div.p: What this shows: The CIM/datamodel, tag and governance evidence contributing to data quality.
How to use it: Use this to understand whether quality concerns are caused by weak CIM alignment, missing tags, or incomplete governance mappings.
Read it as: A Data Source can be structurally good but still have lower operational quality if CIM, tagging or governance evidence is incomplete.

search.query:
| where in_datamodel=1 | mvexpand datamodels | rename datamodels as datamodel
| stats dc(field_name) as matched_fields values(field_name) as field_examples values(observed_tags) as observed_tags max(event_count) as event_count by group_value datamodel
| join type=left max=0 datamodel [ | inputlookup cim_datamodel_tags_lookup | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval expected_tag=lower(trim(expected_tag)) | stats values(expected_tag) as expected_tags by datamodel ]
| join type=left max=0 datamodel [ | inputlookup governance_datamodel_mapping_lookup | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval framework=trim(framework) | stats values(framework) as frameworks by datamodel ]
| eval observed_tags=mvmap(observed_tags, lower(trim(observed_tags))) | eval expected_tags_for_eval=if(isnull(expected_tags),"__no_expected_tag__",expected_tags) | mvexpand expected_tags_for_eval | eval tag_hit=if(expected_tags_for_eval!="__no_expected_tag__" AND mvfind(observed_tags, expected_tags_for_eval)>=0,1,0)
| eventstats max(tag_hit) as any_expected_tag_observed by group_value datamodel
| eval tag_status=case( isnull(expected_tags),"No related CIM tag mapping", any_expected_tag_observed=1,"Related CIM tag observed", true(),"Related CIM tag not observed" ) | eval governance_status=if(isnotnull(frameworks),"Governance mapped","Unmapped")
| stats max(matched_fields) as matched_fields values(field_examples) as field_examples values(observed_tags) as observed_tags values(expected_tags) as related_cim_tags values(frameworks) as frameworks values(tag_status) as tag_status values(governance_status) as governance_status max(event_count) as event_count by group_value datamodel
| rename group_value as "Data Source" | rename datamodel as "Datamodel" | rename matched_fields as "Matched Fields" | rename tag_status as "Tagging Status" | rename governance_status as "Governance Mapping Status" | rename related_cim_tags as "Related CIM Tags" | rename observed_tags as "Observed Tags" | rename frameworks as "Frameworks" | rename field_examples as "Matched Field Examples" | rename event_count as "Events Analysed" | table "Data Source" Datamodel "Matched Fields" "Tagging Status" "Governance Mapping Status" "Related CIM Tags" "Observed Tags" Frameworks "Matched Field Examples" "Events Analysed" | sort "Data Source" - "Matched Fields" Datamodel
